text:
Devon: Heads-up — planning a ship at 2026-03-17 23:00 UTC (T+2h). This is the inference-cost-optimizations rollout: batching throttle updates, routing fallback tweak, and a small Console UI change for rollout toggles.

Ana: +1. Who's owning the deploy?

Devon: I will. Samir on rollback and Mira doing smoke checks. Olivia on release notes and marketing assets. CS Lead — can you prep the CS playbook and a short FAQ?

CS Lead: On it. Will draft the playbook and share by 22:00 UTC. Anything user-facing that could change behavior?

Devon: Two subtle changes: 1) default batching threshold lowered (should reduce cost, negligible perf diff); 2) routing will prefer lower-cost region when latency delta < 40ms. No DB migrations. No schema changes.

Mira: Smoke checklist (I'll run these post-canary):
```
# smoke commands
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"input":"quick summary"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.tokens'
# check console route metrics: /console/api/routes?since=1h
# validate canary throughput at 50rps for 10m
```

Samir: Rollback plan: instant traffic shift back to v2026-03-16 via router feature-flag. If canary errors > 1% for 5m or latency p95 increases > 200ms, I'll flip the flag. I'll be on-call for the window.

Deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z by Devon to canary (10% traffic) then gradual rollout to 100% over 30m if no alerts.

Olivia: I have a short release blurb for marketing and a GIF of Console changes. Will ping marketing with assets in 30m. Do we need a customer email?

Marketing Lead: Not required for all users — let's do a blog post next week. For today, social + changelog is fine. Send assets to #marketing-assets.

Devon: Canaries go at 23:00. Mira — please confirm the smoke checklist passes by 23:10. If green, we'll move to 50% at 23:20, then 100% by 23:50.

Mira: Copy. Will post results here as soon as each step completes.

CS Lead: I'll stub the playbook with :steps and include quick rollback steps, known side-effects, and how to escalate (pager + slack). ETA 22:30 for draft.

Release Manager: Please ensure changelog entry in the repo: `docs/changelog/2026-03-17.md` and link to the PR. Olivia, ping me when assets are live so I can coordinate the console banner.

Devon: One more: if any perf regressions show up in `redwood-runtime` traces, tag @eng-runtime. I'll be monitoring SLOs and logs. Good luck team :rocket: 

Mira: Canary started — running basic inference, console checks, and verifying logs. First 5m looks clean.

Samir: Watchlist created. If anything, I'll call rollback.

Olivia: Assets uploaded to #marketing-assets and GDrive. Blurb: "Reducing inference costs with smarter batching and routing — gradual rollout starting now."

Devon: 23:12 — moving to 50% after Mira's green.

Mira: 50% smoke checks passed. No errors and latency stable.

Devon: Moving to 100% now.

Deploy-bot: Deployment complete: 100% traffic on v2026-03-17. Duration 47m.

CS Lead: Playbook posted in Confluence: /spaces/CS/pages/Inference-2026-03-17. Added canned messages and escalation flow.

Olivia: Done — marketing posted changelog and social draft scheduled.

Samir: All quiet on rollback front. Keeping monitoring for 2h post-deploy.

Devon: Thanks everyone. If you see anything odd, drop a note here and we'll act.
